audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers carry the chart [Gangplank, Skill, Akali, Akali, Gangplank, Akali, Akali], which contradicts the packet chart [Gangplank, Skill, Skill, Skill, Akali, Akali, Gangplank] and contradicts their own why text.
audit.why: whys[2] says 'neither can hard-commit' (even) and whys[3] says 'we trade around her shroud... bank small leads' (even) — those are Skill rows, not Akali. whys[4] says her R's two dashes plus the execute let her all-in over the barrels — that is Akali at level 6, not Gangplank. whys[6] and spikes[3] both say chained keg detonations delete her from range — that is Gangplank at 2+ items, not Akali. Packet agrees with the text on all four rows.
audit.corrected: Levels 3 and 4-5 = Skill, Level 6 = Akali, 2+ items = Gangplank. Proposed as one atomic chart group across both layers with ratings adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's spike story credits Gangplank at level 6 and gives Akali the 2-item window — the reverse of how the spikes actually fall.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s and its second cast executes below a threshold, so level 6 is her window while you are poked down. Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s — her pre-6 commit. Gangplank's real spike is 2+ items, where a full keg chain into empowered Parrrley kills her from outside her 675 R range.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Akali, 2+ items to Gangplank; cooldown breakdown rewritten around Twilight Shroud 20s, Shuriken Flip 16s and Remove Scurvy 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer repeats 'untargetable inside, poke when down' without stating what that costs you, and never mentions Assassin's Mark. dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[*].d are boilerplate that does not match their own titles.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud makes her unable to be selected by spells and attacks, so a Parrrley or a keg detonation aimed into the cloud is spent for nothing — that is the decisive interaction and the content layer already knows it while the full layer does not. Assassin's Mark rings you on spell damage and empowers her next attack when you leave the ring, so her step-out wind-up is the step-back cue, not her cast.
audit.corrected: Stated the wasted-cast rule in tldr, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t; added the Assassin's Mark tell to dontsFull[2].d and the Perfect Execution threshold to dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Akali as 'he' in tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.feeding and report text.
audit.why: Boilerplate pronoun carried over from a template; the content layer uses 'she'.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tradeGood; the remaining instances are the same template string reused and are noted for a bulk pass.

edits.before: Build MR — barrel-poke her off shroud, all-in. Gangplank wins the Twilight Shroud cooldown windows.
edits.after: Build MR, poke her off Twilight Shroud, and never fire a keg or Parrrley blind into the cloud.

edits.before: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Akali steps to farm, and orange away whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Akali steps up to farm, and Remove Scurvy her Q slow after.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Poke when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1 — she is unselectable inside, so poke only once it is down. - Shuriken Flip: 16s, her one commit before 6. - Remove Scurvy: 22s, hold it for her all-in, not for chip damage.

edits.before: Untargetable inside. Poke when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unselectable inside it (20s at rank 1) — bait it out, then trade while it is down.

edits.before: Akali wastes Twilight Shroud — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Detonate outside the cloud; a keg fired into it is spent on nothing.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: She is unselectable inside — refuse the fight until she steps out to commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution executes below a threshold — never idle low after 6.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Assassin's Mark rings you on spell damage — leaving the ring empowers her next auto, so that step-out is the tell.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside. Poke when down. When it is down — Barrel-Q + R her.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable — kegs and Parrrley fired into the cloud are wasted. Bait it, then chain.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — watch the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's two dashes plus the execute cross your barrels — if you are poked low, Cannon Barrage will not save you here.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Chained keg detonations into Parrrley kill her from outside her 675 R range — deny the shroud reset and she dies mid-combo.

notes: Both packet suspectNames are false positives — 'Twilight Shroud' is the correct W name in both places. The full layer still calls Akali 'he' in tradeBad, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, report[3].t, report[11].t, report[12].t and report[13].t; those are template strings shared across matchups, so I fixed only tradeGood rather than propose seven near-identical rewrites.
